reverted_title: Mxfp4MoeBackend.TRITON_UNFUSED fallback
reason_evidence: `Mxfp4MoeBackend.TRITON_UNFUSED` does not comply with the `requested_activation_key`
rationale: The PR removes a ROCm MXFP4 MoE fallback added by #45896 because it ignored the requested activation quantization key.

reverted_title: [KV Offload] Use background thread for mmap / cpu_tensors pinning
rationale: The title and target identify a full revert of the KV offload background pinning change, but the record only links an issue for the reason.

reverted_title: [ci][build] limit cmake version
reason_evidence: since the new cmake version 3.31 bugfix is released
rationale: This reverts the temporary CMake version limit after the upstream CMake packaging bug was fixed.

reverted_title: [CI][XPU] Disable model runner V2 for XPU quantization test
reason_evidence: #54809 already fixes this on `main`, so #56179's `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0` workaround is no longer needed.
rationale: The CI workaround disabling MRV2 on XPU is reverted because the underlying XPU hang had already been fixed.

reverted_title: [Startup] Parallelize torch/transformers import + weight prefetch + forkserver prewarm
reason_evidence: causing the recent main failures
rationale: The startup parallelization PR is fully reverted because it was suspected of causing failures on main.

reverted_title: [bench] Support common prefix len config (for decode-only bench)
reason_evidence: Should just use `--random-prefix-len` instead.
rationale: The benchmark option change is reverted because the existing random-prefix option should be used instead.

reverted_title: [Perf][ROCm] Dual-stream decode with hipgraphs
reason_evidence: failed CI due to poor gsm8k acc for Qwen3.5 with DP2EP
rationale: The ROCm dual-stream fused-MoE performance change was reverted after CI exposed accuracy problems in DP/EP hybrid models.

reverted_title: [SM100] Enable fp8 compute for prefill MLA
reason_evidence: Revert #30746 untill #30993 is merged.
rationale: The SM100 FP8 prefill MLA kernel path is reverted pending a prerequisite PR.

reverted_title: [NemotronH] Do not force router to run in fp32
reason_evidence: #34582 introduced an accuracy degradation.
rationale: The performance-motivated router precision change is reverted because it degraded Nemotron accuracy.

reverted_title: [LoRA] Support FusedMoE LoRA Triton kernel for mxfp4
reason_evidence: breaking the following tests from nightly
rationale: The MXFP4 FusedMoE LoRA Triton kernel support is reverted after nightly tests failed.

reverted_title: token rank comparison difference
reason_evidence: Making this consistent with V1 will help with output equivalence tests.
rationale: This rolls the token-rank comparison back to the V1-equivalent behavior to avoid an orthogonal behavior change.

reverted_title: gpt-oss max cudagraph size change
reason_evidence: the restriction is lifted now
rationale: The gpt-oss cudagraph-size cap is rolled back after the later prerequisite removed the restriction.

reverted_title: AITER version v0.1.12
reason_evidence: there are many known issues with the initial commit of v0.1.12
rationale: This explicitly rolls the ROCm AITER dependency back to v0.1.10.post3 because v0.1.12 had known issues.

reverted_title: offline_inference.py example change
reason_evidence: keep the `offline_inference.py` example as simple as possible
rationale: Only the offline_inference.py example part of #10392 is revoked and moved to a separate CLI example.

reverted_title: test_quark_int8_w8a8_moe change
reason_evidence: This test is flaky
rationale: The AMD quantization test definition from #53291 is rolled back because the test became flaky.

reverted_title: [Refactor] Remove redundant TP gather/split in split_qkv in QwenVL
reason_evidence: the model generates incorrect output when TP is used
rationale: Only the Qwen2-VL portion of the QwenVL TP refactor is reverted because TP produced wrong outputs for that model.

reverted_title: [MRV2] Always build attn metadata at capture time
reason_evidence: EngineCore process crashes with a **GPU coredump** during CUDA graph capture
rationale: The MRV2 cudagraph attention metadata change is auto-reverted after an H200 FlashAttention capture crash.

reverted_title: Use Cache Hinting for fused_moe kernel
reason_evidence: Internal Triton PTX codegen error caught in later CI
rationale: The fused_moe cache-hinting kernel optimization is reverted due to Triton code generation compatibility errors.

reverted_title: [Doc] update installation guide regarding aarch64+cuda pytorch build
reason_evidence: See if the failing tests on main can be resolved
rationale: The documentation/docker install update is reverted as an experiment to recover failing main tests.

reverted_title: move apply w8a8 block fp8 linear to class
reason_evidence: resolves the issue (#25623) raised in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/25607
rationale: This re-applies a W8A8 block-FP8 linear performance change with a fix for the issue that caused the earlier revert.

reverted_title: `uncache_blocks`
reason_evidence: it's unsafe to uncache a block because it may be used by more than one requests
rationale: The unsafe uncache_blocks behavior is reverted while adding a safer recaching path for full blocks.

reason_evidence: #49969 accidentally reverted #50869 when resolving a merge conflict.
rationale: This re-applies PR #50869 after it was accidentally lost during conflict resolution.
The change only adds timeout headroom after a separate rollback and does not itself undo earlier code.

reverted_title: [CI/Build] Remove redundant OpenTelemetry pip install from CI configs
reason_evidence: broke `v1/tracing/test_tracing.py::test_traces`
rationale: The CI cleanup removing an OpenTelemetry install is reverted because it broke a tracing test.

reverted_title: [compile][startup] Disable C++ compilation of symbolic shapes
rationale: The symbolic-shape compile optimization is fully reverted, but the record only links issue comments for the reason.

reverted_title: [Misc] Remove use of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for device selection
reason_evidence: is breaking external launcher mode DP
rationale: The CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES device-selection change is reverted because it broke external-launcher data parallel mode.

reverted_title: [Frontend] CompilationConfig overhaul (#20283)
reason_evidence: Fix compile tests in distributed tests CI
rationale: The CompilationConfig frontend overhaul is reverted to fix distributed compile-test failures.

reverted_title: [Bugfix] Disable TRTLLM attention when KV transfer is enabled
reason_evidence: Query dtype mismatch: expected torch.bfloat16, got torch.float8_e4m3fn
rationale: The Blackwell TRTLLM-attention workaround is reverted because it introduced a query dtype mismatch for FP8 P/D disaggregation.

reverted_title: [ROCm][Perf] Kimi-K3 Fused kernels for KDA prefill
reason_evidence: error: '__builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16' needs target feature gfx950-insts
rationale: The ROCm Kimi-K3 fused KDA prefill kernels are reverted because they failed to compile in multi-architecture AMD images.

reverted_title: Consolidate AWQ quantization into single awq_marlin.py file
reason_evidence: REVERT Accidental push
rationale: The AWQ quantization consolidation is reverted because it was accidentally pushed.

reverted_title: Zero-init MLA attention output buffers to prevent NaN from CUDA graph padding
reason_evidence: removing the overhead of pre-allocated zero-init buffers
rationale: The MLA zero-initialization workaround is reverted because it added overhead and did not solve the underlying NaN issue.

reverted_title: [V1][Core] Fix memory issue with logits & sampling
reason_evidence: This broke LoRA
rationale: The V1 logits/sampling memory fix is reverted because it broke LoRA tests.

reverted_title: [v1] Add fp32 support to v1 engine through flex attn
rationale: The V1 fp32-through-FlexAttention support is fully reverted without a stated failure in the record.

reverted_title: [Agents] Link Triton skill to JIT kernel warmup guide
reason_evidence: causes the agent to wrap every single Triton kernel with the warmup framework
rationale: The agent-skill documentation link is reverted because it made generated kernel code too verbose.

reverted_title: re-direction to amd_mi355_X
rationale: The AMD CI redirection is explicitly rolled back, but no failure reason is stated.

reverted_title: max_prompt_len validation for decoder-only models
reason_evidence: This change breaks inputs for decoder-only models
rationale: The decoder-only max_prompt_len validation behavior is rolled back because it rejected valid prompts at the limit.

reverted_title: [Doc] Fix RTD build: pytorch.org/docs/stable/objects.inv returns 404
reason_evidence: Fixed upstream by pytorch/docs#85.
rationale: The documentation workaround for the PyTorch inventory URL is reverted after the upstream docs issue was fixed.

reverted_title: custom attention mask for gemma3-mm
reason_evidence: fix gemma3 test
rationale: The Gemma3 multimodal attention-mask change is partially reverted to make the Gemma3 test pass.

reverted_title: Flex attention backend selection logic
reason_evidence: accidentally removed in PR #26980
rationale: This restores ROCm FlexAttention backend selection that had been accidentally removed by #26980.

reverted_title: default `max_num_seqs` of 1024
reason_evidence: many people have run into OOM when using V1
rationale: The V1 default max_num_seqs is rolled back to V0 values for most hardware because users hit OOMs.

reverted_title: [Misc] Move `pyav` and `soundfile` to common requirements
rationale: The dependency-requirements move is fully reverted, but the record only points to a Slack discussion for the reason.

reverted_title: [PerfFix] Avoid separate thread for MP executor shm spin
reason_evidence: Observe request getting stuck
rationale: The MP executor performance fix is reverted because it made P/D deployments with TP>1 get stuck.

reverted_title: doc: add info for macos clang errors
rationale: The macOS clang documentation addition is reverted as a follow-up doc cleanup without a stated bug.

reverted_title: [Misc] Add S3 environment variables for better support of MinIO.
rationale: The MinIO S3 environment variable support PR is fully reverted with no reason stated in the record.
Here rollback is part of llguidance grammar state handling, not an undo of a previous merged change.
